8396417

Hi all,

  please review this fix for Parallel GC verification: `oopDesc::verify()` fails iterating over forwarded, promotion failed objects with a compressed header. It just tries to dereference the compressed oop header as klass and crashes.

The fix is to just not try to verify promotion failed objects. They are effectively dead anyway.

Testing: gha, test case

Thanks,
  Thomas
